title: SentimentAnalysis
description: Extract sentiment analysis information from a customer review.

overall_sentiment.description: Overall sentiment of the review (Positive, Negative, or Neutral)

positive_points.description: List of positive points mentioned in the review

negative_points.description: List of negative points mentioned in the review

suggested_improvements.description: Suggestions to improve the product or service

recommendation.description: Whether the product is recommended (Yes, No, or Maybe)

emotion.description: Primary emotion expressed by the reviewer
